networkAccess.reasoning: The panel talks to the Archetype API to sign you in, create a persona study for the selected prototype flow, run it and read its results. It sends the file and page names, the names of the screens on the path, the goal and the user description you type, and the prototype share link if you paste one. When a test launches, and before each later round, it sends the prototype's flow map: every screen's name and visible text, its drawn connections, and the labels and nearby text of the elements without a connection, so Archetype and its AI model provider can read where each one leads. During a test, every step sends a screenshot of the screen a persona sees, its visible text and what can be clicked to Archetype and its AI model provider, so the persona can see and act on what you built.
